messages.content: Hey, my blood pressure meds ran out. Doc said I need a new script but my pharmacy is 45 min away. Can you help?
I can't handle scripts or refills directly, but I'm escalating you to a nurse right now. They'll coordinate with your doctor and pharmacy. Wait time is usually about 31 hours.
31 hours? What if my blood pressure goes up before I get the new pills?
That's a clinical question and I can't advise on it. That's exactly why the nurse is taking over. Have ready when they call: when you ran out, any recent BP readings, and your pharmacy name/number.
Got it. Can you help arrange a ride to the pharmacy?
I can't arrange transport, but the nurse will help coordinate with your pharmacy and doc. Let's check in Friday to make sure everything came through. That work for you?
